subject: OpenLib demo request \u0014 Redwood + GitHub integration
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@openlib.dev>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request  Redwood + OpenLib (saw on GitHub)

Hi Marissa,

I maintain a project called OpenLib (https://github.com/openlib/openlib) and saw a mention of Redwood in an issue thread  looks like your inference offering might solve some of our scaling problems around embeddings and code generation. We self-host some components but are evaluating hosted/dedicated options for near real-time gen + embeddings for search.

Would love a quick demo to see how Redwood would fit with a GitHub-driven workflow (webhooks/CI, model catalog, on-prem options). A 20-30 minute overview + Q&A would be great.

Some context: we are a small team (3 engs actively integrating), open-source core, some enterprise contributors. Key questions: repo-based integration workflows, data retention for vector indexes, and private deployment options.

Best,
Alex Nguyen
Maintainer, OpenLib
alex@openlib.dev
https://openlib.dev

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@openlib.dev>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request  Redwood + OpenLib (saw on GitHub)

Hi Alex - thanks for reaching out and for the context! Super relevant for our typical users. Rafael (AE) is cc'd and will join the call where helpful.

I can do a 20-30min demo - quick options: Wed 3/4 10:00-10:30 PT, Thu 3/5 09:00-09:30 PT, or Fri 3/6 11:00-11:30 PT. If none of those work, feel free to pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

A couple of quick asks so we can tailor the demo:
- Which integration path interests you most (hosted API, dedicated, or private/VPC)?
- Any specific repositories or a GitHub issue/PR we should review beforehand?

I'll include a short agenda and the integration brief in the invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Alex Nguyen <alex@openlib.dev>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenLib Maintainers <maintainers@openlib.dev>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request  Redwood + OpenLib (saw on GitHub)

Thanks Marissa - I booked Thu 3/5 09:00 PT via your Calendly link. I've cc'd our maintainers list so they can join if available.

To answer your questions:
- We're most interested in a hosted/dedicated path first - evaluate hosted for speed, and dedicated if we need predictable throughput.
- Relevant context: https://github.com/openlib/openlib/issues/142 (we've been discussing inference infra there).

Two quick technical questions to include in the demo if you can:
1) GitHub-triggered ingestion: can Redwood ingest updates triggered from a repo webhook (we push new embeddings as commits happen)?
2) Private indexes: any recommended patterns for isolating open-source vectors vs enterprise private vectors?

Appreciate it - looking forward to the call.

- Alex
